const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive controller for the live RoboTwin standard-mode episode.
+
+Run this once and send one JSON command per line on stdin.  The process keeps a
+single Robot client connected for the whole episode.  Supported commands:
+  {"op":"observe", "seconds":0, "depth":true}
+  {"op":"ee_pose", "rows":[[...16 values...], ...], "video":"both"}
+  {"op":"joint_position", "rows":[[...14 values...], ...], "dt":0.05}
+"quit" exits the client.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAPTURES = OUT / "captures"
+CAPTURES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save_result(result, label):
+    dest = CAPTURES / label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (dest / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2))
+    for camera, frame in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(frame)).save(dest / f"{camera}.jpg", quality=95)
+    for camera, depth in result.depth.items():
+        np.save(dest / f"{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+    if result.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(dest / "proprio.npy", result.proprio)
+    for camera, frames in result.frames.items():
+        if len(frames):
+            Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(frames[-1])).save(dest / f"{camera}_last_video.jpg", quality=95)
+    for camera, video in result.video.items():
+        (dest / f"{camera}.mp4").write_bytes(video)
+    return str(dest)
+
+
+robot = Robot()
+spec = robot.spec()
+print(json.dumps({"connected": True, "spec": spec}, default=str), flush=True)
+initial = robot.get_obs(include_depth=True, video="none")
+save_path = save_result(initial, "initial")
+print(json.dumps({"observation": "initial", "path": save_path,
+                  "meta": initial.meta,
+                  "proprio": initial.meta.get("proprio", {})}, default=str), flush=True)
+
+step = 0
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    line = line.strip()
+    if not line:
+        continue
+    if line == "quit":
+        break
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        op = cmd["op"]
+        if op == "observe":
+            result = robot.get_obs(seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 0)),
+                                   include_depth=bool(cmd.get("depth", False)),
+                                   video=cmd.get("video", "frames"))
+        elif op in ("ee_pose", "joint_position"):
+            rows = np.asarray(cmd["rows"], dtype=np.float32)
+            if rows.ndim == 1:
+                rows = rows[None, :]
+            result = robot.submit(op, rows, dt=float(cmd.get("dt", 0.05)),
+                                  video=cmd.get("video", "both"),
+                                  include_depth=bool(cmd.get("depth", False)),
+                                  note=cmd.get("note", "place_container_plate"))
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported op: {op}")
+        step += 1
+        save_path = save_result(result, f"step_{step:02d}")
+        print(json.dumps({"step": step, "op": op, "path": save_path,
+                          "meta": result.meta,
+                          "proprio": result.proprio.tolist() if result.proprio is not None else None},
+                         default=str), flush=True)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}, flush=True)
+        if type(exc).__name__ == "EpisodeOver":
+            break
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
